applies_to: All future environment and prop revisions across the game
rules: Recompose spaces from coherent detailed ImageGen direction and authored Blender assets rather than inheriting arbitrary legacy prop positions
Remove obsolete decorative pieces as part of the authored rebuild; do not preserve them merely to fill space
Preserve or deliberately replace gameplay functions: collisions, navigation, doors, switches, weapons, objectives and checkpoints
Confirm exact ImageGen and Blender asset coverage before declaring a rebuilt space complete
Use the approved pool environment, detailed mourning angel and user reference images as minimum quality references
Validate complete room composition, meaningful furniture orientation, physical volume, lighting and gameplay readability before integration approval
current_reference_status: User-approved art direction on 2026-10-08; Blender reconstruction and gameplay integration remain pending
approval_scope: Guest room visual detail, materials, lighting and composition direction; does not approve current Blender prototype or certify runtime quality
